h66d25cfec0ba: Seven things others don't have, or don't do comfortably
h420859f292c2: These are what actually set it apart from a plain image viewer — and why it deserves its own install.
h6ee42b3d3e0e: Chinese substring search: two characters and it's there
h28cd15d6d303: Most libraries require a whole word or tokenise first, so typing 'seaside sun' finds nothing for 'seaside sunset backlit'. Here a character-level full-text index matches anywhere — very visible in Chinese.
hb8ca7de44958: Why it's rare: getting Chinese right without tokenisation and staying fast takes a lot of extra index work; most products simply skip it.
h5fe25875dd68: Remember the picture, not the file: local semantic search
he2953e297f71: You've forgotten the filename, the tags, even the year — but you remember 'that blue-toned one with someone standing by the window'. Describe it; 49 ms across 20,000 images.
h74707815b397: Why it's rare: the model runs on your own machine, so no images are uploaded and no cloud credits are burned.
hb4d298bde535: Drag it out and use it: wired into your design tools
h89057a3ad84c: Drag a selection straight onto a Photoshop canvas or into Figma — it arrives as an image, without exporting to the desktop first.
h289f805df432: Why it's rare: web products structurally can't do it; desktop products usually don't bother with the extra step.
h4f1414d22c0c: Share a selection without going to the cloud
hefede1b33ad6: LAN read-only sharing: generate a link or QR code and anyone on the same network can browse your selection in a browser — with a password, an expiry and downloads disabled if you like.
he7a52bb8daeb: Why it's rare: most products turn sharing into a cloud funnel; fully local products often skip it altogether.
h3d5b3babcec5: Edit without destroying: operation log + two-stack undo
ha61b2742a97d: Crop, grade and erase are recorded as operations; the original file stays byte-identical. Undo back, redo forward, or roll back to any historical version.
h5d05593a7eb7: Why it's rare: real non-destructive editing reshapes the whole storage model; many products just back up a copy and overwrite.
hbe85e781bcc2: Let your AI assistant read your library directly
h8b221dca3ba5: A built-in MCP server and a permissioned local API: AI clients can search, list favourites and apply smart folders on your instruction — not just chat, but act.
h84eb3d56d551: Why it's rare: it means opening up the data interface, which most commercial products won't do.
h6fd5b815f6c1: Scrolling doesn't load everything at once: keyset-cursor paging, indexed lists and a separately throttled thumbnail queue. 12 ms deep paging, 10 ms keyword search.
hf8d7aab62e32: Why it's rare: most comparable products start spinning at the 20,000-image mark.

h764c47eca76e: Let's be clear about where it falls short
hb7b4cff62f23: An overview that only lists strengths is useless. These are the real weaknesses, and why they exist.
h9537f0468113: No code-signing certificate. The installer and main executable may be flagged as 'unknown publisher' by 360 / Huorong / Defender. Verifying the SHA256 in the release notes is the only reliable self-check; after installing, 'Settings → Data & Maintenance → Software integrity' can detect and restore quarantined files.
h0e5cb8821f97: Only Windows has been validated. macOS / Linux have build configs but no real-machine validation, so they aren't claimed as supported; system OCR is Windows-only as well.
h249af9e01505: No cloud sync, no mobile app, no multi-user collaboration. The closest substitutes are LAN read-only sharing and sync-folder snapshots — the first only works on the same network, the second only syncs library files, not originals.
h4af3baca0696: The English UI still has blind spots. UI, tutorial and docs are bilingual, but AI provider and model settings still display Chinese.
haa3e8dbfd14b: 20,000 images are solid; million-scale is still a goal. Grid, timeline and playlists are all windowed, so scrolling doesn't slow as the library grows — but million-scale only has a benchmark script, no real-machine validation.
hdb4f580ca1d1: AI is slow the first time. The semantic model runs on CPU and the first run downloads about 90 MB of weights; whatever can't finish during the day can be picked up by nightly batch processing.
h5ab9787b11bf: The installer is large (about 138 MB). It bundles the Node runtime, image processing and inference libraries; unused parts are trimmed per platform, but it still isn't light.
h6e9b7ff2097b: Why these shortcomings? This is a single-machine-first product: originals are never uploaded, no account is created, data never leaves the machine. Cloud sync, collaboration and accounts aren't 'too hard to build' — building them means being responsible every month for storage, bandwidth, backups and outages. That's an ongoing cost and a different product. So they are explicitly out of scope for this version, instead of being vaguely promised as 'coming soon'.
hc4ac5de24601: It may fit you exactly, or not at all
he37f76a51383: If you nodded at more than three items in the 'suits you' column, it's worth an install — your assets stay on your own drive, and uninstalling won't take them away or damage them. If you hit any item in the other column, don't force it: this version genuinely isn't designed for that.
